role: Characterisation tests for RoadAwarenessEngine (pure road-graph snap, lookahead and spoken phrase for the AI Coach) using invented OSM-like tiles at 40N/40W; three XCTestCase classes share a private RoadFixture enum.
types: RoadFixture: enum (private) — builders for points, segments, nodes, tiles, CLLocations, a crossroads tile and a chain tile
RoadAwarenessGeometryTests: class — haversine, bearing, projection, formatDistance, bearingTrust
RoadAwarenessPhrasingTests: class — constructPhrase, phraseFromFallback, pure awareness(for:tile:)
toplevel: File-scope private enum RoadFixture with static builders. Doc comment at lines 98-105 (Main St/Oak diagram) sits above snapFixture but describes crossroadsTile.

flags.text: Phrasing and formatDistance assertions compare exact English strings ('on Main St, approaching Oak Ave in 328 ft', '0.2 mi'); production localizes via LanguageManager.appBundle and formats with LanguageManager.appLocale, so the tests pass only when the host app language/locale is English.

units.does: Builds a RoadGraphService.Point from lat/lon.
Builds a RoadSegment with id, optional name/ref, highway class (default residential), geometry and nodeIds; oneway flags false.
Builds a GraphNode with id, coord, wayIds, tags and roundabout flag.
Builds a Tile centred at 40,-40 from segment and node arrays keyed by id, fetchedAt epoch 0.
Builds a CLLocation with explicit course (default 90), courseAccuracy (5), speed (2.5), 5 m accuracies, epoch timestamp.
Builds a SnapResult (segment 1, given name/ref, residential, forward=true, confidence 0.9, 4 m) for phrasing tests.

Builds the crossroads tile: Main St as two ways (1: nodes 100-101, 2: 101-102) east-west at 0.001° (~85 m) steps, and Oak Ave (way 3) crossing north-south through node 101; node 101 optionally flagged onRoundaboutWay.
Builds a chain of segmentCount same-named 'Long Rd' ways of stepDegrees longitude, with a 'Cross i' way hanging north off every interior node, and nodes listing their incident ways.

branches.effect: appends a Long Rd way and records its two endpoint nodes' way ids
appends a Cross i way and its far node; records way ids on junction and cross nodes (traps if segmentCount < 1 since 1..<0 is invalid)
appends a node with its collected way ids
?? [] gives the node no ways (cannot happen: every main node got at least one way in the first loop)

flags.text: The pure awareness(for:tile:) call takes constructPhrase's default imperial argument, which reads UnitsPreferenceStore.current from the host app's App Group UserDefaults (and may migrate a legacy value into it); the test therefore depends on the app host's stored unit preference and only asserts the suffix is ' ft' or ' m' rather than a pinned distance string.
